summary: Round 2 spec review at c69666cf. All seven round 1 findings are resolved or superseded by the amended spec and plan. The paraphrase is clean, the zoom-out and zero-decision checks pass, and the plan facts hold: all 30 civic P2 rows have a source, a design note, a mockup, and two shots. The judge family rule, the batch size, the evidence paths, and the per-map record are defined. One Nit remains: the stop rule counts a third and fourth rating while the plan caps a map at one rework and one rerate.
nonblocking_findings: F8 [Nit] spec.md Rework rule and plan.md Phase 3 stop rule: The stop rule names a third and a fourth rating, but the plan caps a map at one rework and one rerate. Rationale: The recorded MAPS rating and the one-rework cap fix the end state as follow-up, so only the wording can mislead.

Zoom-out check: the plan delivers the purpose of owning all civic rows with independent evidence. No speculative feature and no premature optimization appear. Reuse claims cite files and symbols. New records stay in measure/tracks and measure/runs, and the TSV stays the acceptance record.

The judge family rule is sound: ra-quota pick supports --not-family filters, the default maker family for the 2026-10 batch is Anthropic Sonnet, and vision-review ranks a non-claude route first.
The plan facts hold: 97 scripts/design-*.mjs exist, hamlet.html and scripts/shoot-map.mjs exist, and the shoot command in Phase 3 matches the usage in shoot-map.mjs.

paraphrase.proposes: This track owns the 30 civic P2 rows of the 100-scene blueprint list. The 30 map sources already exist, so the track inventories each map source, design note, shots, and log rating. An independent judge then rates each map against its design note at 7.0 out of 10 or higher. A map below the bar gets one rework and one rerate. The track then writes accepted or follow-up into the blueprint TSV.
paraphrase.current_system: The 30 maps live at scenes/maps/<slug>.ts and load through the glob in src/scene/main.ts. Each map has a generated design note and three images in docs/map-mockups/. The blueprint TSV still marks the 30 rows mockup-needed, which is stale. docs/map-review.html shows the earlier orchestrator ratings from bench/sonnet/log.tsv, and no tool reads that page. The rubric review.md sets the bar, the reviewer rule, and the main-body scale rule.
